Architecture direction from Jack Heart (2026-11-22) on eliminating 92k-key S3/R2 LIST bottlenecks and scaling live views/reports:

- On 5.3 s / 99-page R2 LIST overhead: "This seems like it wants a redesign on ourpart."
- "or potentially we just need some sort of aggregation worker"
- "and also, we could have the jobs do more ush to the server rather tan just requiring on pulling hte s3"

Target model for follow-up / team server:
- Jobs/couriers push newly sealed metric blocks, checkpoints, eval batches, console chunks, and system samples directly to the server's aggregation worker / derived DB (fast path, zero S3/R2 LIST polling, non-blocking so server outages never hurt training).
- Canonical files still flush to S3/R2 ("you own your own data"), with the aggregation worker backfilling/reconciling from the bucket when needed.
